lines: After the army, I walked the Israel National Trail. Forty two kilometers on my twenty fifth birthday.
Then I crossed America by road, from San Francisco all the way to New York.
In twenty sixteen, I founded English Express, on Sokolov Street in Tel Aviv.
Every English Speaker gets a personal coach, a community, and daily habits. In that order.
Fifty one ExpressX nights, with our English Speakers on stage.
